key_insight: A two-phase causal discovery and clustering workflow revealed how welding stack-up factors drive resistance-weld signal morphology beyond simple correlations.
engineering_relevance: The findings can help engineers interpret high-frequency spot-welding data, improve process setup across varying materials and geometries, and support more transferable quality monitoring.
method: Causal discovery on high-dimensional time-series process signals
Time series clustering to group representative weld profiles
Analysis across heterogeneous stack-ups with different materials, coatings, thicknesses, and electrode guns
evidence_signal: The study analyzed 15,096 representative profiles extracted from more than 1.8 million welds and linked stack-up variables to measurable changes in resistance, displacement, force, and peak timing.
watch_item: Because the framework is data-rich and configuration-specific, deploying it reliably in new production settings may still require careful validation on unseen stack-up combinations.
paper_title: Causal discovery of signal morphology drivers in steel resistance spot welding: a high-dimensional data analysis
